messages:
Lydia (AE): Heads-up - Quantis pushed this up to execs. They want a short plan for POC blockers + a 30-min exec sync this week. Core asks: EU-only data residency, 95th perc latency <150ms for 2k concurrent sessions, and committed Dedicated pricing with an escape clause.
Marco (SE): Attached baseline from yesterday. Notice throughput collapse ~1.6k concurrent. Suspect cache eviction thrash rather than GC.
Priya (SE): app logs don't show GC spikes, but KV cache churn is visible. I can reproduce locally with their seed.
Lydia (AE): CTO expects remediation plan + timelines by Thu EOD. Also asked for an executive one-pager for CFO on TCO.
Marco (SE): quick config snapshot from run:
```
model: rwd-7b-quant (q4)
instance: gpu-a100-40gb
batch_size: 8
cache_ttl: 60s
enable_prefetch: false
```
I can try cache_ttl=300s and batch_size=4 for a canary.
Priya (SE): Proposed diff:
```
- cache_ttl: 60s
+ cache_ttl: 300s
- batch_size: 8
+ batch_size: 4
- enable_prefetch: false
+ enable_prefetch: true
```
Marco (SE): kicking off A/B tonight; will post perf metrics.
Nora (PM): Need to include fallback plan: route to rwd-3b-quant when capacity constrained and document expected quality delta. I'll draft a 2-slide summary.
Lydia (AE): CTO requested a canary SLA before sign. Wants root cause + mitigation steps by Thu.
Raj (VP Sales): We can offer reserved Dedicated with a performance SLA and a 3-month ramp credit. Legal will need to review any escape clause.
Elena (Legal): Send exact metrics (p95/p99, error %) we propose for the SLA and the telemetry endpoints for audit. Also need KMS/HSM integration confirmation for customer-managed keys.
cindy-deploy-bot: Deployment queued: canary run on cluster-7 (tag: quantis-poc) 2025-09-03T02:33Z.
Marco (SE): Canary started. Baseline: p95=210ms, p99=420ms at 1.6k. Applying cache_ttl=300s & batch_size=4 now.
Lydia (AE): CTO requested exec brief Fri 09:00 UTC with Raj + CTO + Head Infra. Can you make it?
Raj (VP Sales): Yes. Nora, please prepare two slides: 1) POC status + blockers, 2) mitigation plan + timeline + commercial proposal.
Nora (PM): Got it. Draft by Thu noon.
Priya (SE): Data residency note: private deployment in eu-west-1 exists, but customer wants customer-managed KMS. I'll check infra feasibility.
Elena (Legal): Also confirm sub-processor terms and SOC2 export controls.
Marco (SE): Canary re-run results (1900123520): p95=140ms, p99=230ms with cache_ttl=300s and batch_size=4. Throughput steady at 2k; slight quality degradation on long contexts.
Lydia (AE): Good signal. CTO wants a short table of numbers and a sentence on quality vs cost.
Raj (VP Sales): Pricing sketch: 4xA100-40 dedicated cluster at $XXk/month, 20% ramp credit first 3 months, optional 10% for 12-month commit, SLA credit for missed p99.
Elena (Legal): Send SLA metric definitions and telemetry hooks so Legal can draft the clause.
Nora (PM): Rollout plan (proposed):
- Thu: finalize config + final canary (2k sessions)
- Fri 09:00 UTC: exec briefing (Raj, Lydia, customer execs)
- Mon: prod canary with traffic mirror (24h)
- After success: contract sign & provisioning
Lydia (AE): Customer asked marketing for a CFO one-pager comparing monthly TCO vs current vendor. Raj, can you loop in marketing if I DM t-shirt numbers?
Raj (VP Sales): Yes, will loop them in after numbers.
Priya (SE): Technical follow-up: routing to rwd-3b-quant lowers latency but increases hallucination rate on entity extraction by ~6%. Flagging for execs.
Marco (SE): Runbook snippet to apply fix:
```
# increase cache ttl and lower batch size
curl -X POST https://internal-api/redwood/configs/update -d '{"cache_ttl":300, "batch_size":4}' -H 'Authorization: Bearer <token>'
```
Lydia (AE): Next actions: Marco final canary + logs, Nora slides, Raj pricing paragraph, Elena legal checklist, Priya KMS feasibility. Update by Thu 18:00 UTC so we can prep Fri. :thumbsup:
Raj (VP Sales): Acknowledged. I'll be on the Fri call.
Nora (PM): Slide review ping Thu 12:30 UTC.
Elena (Legal): DPA/SLA checklist to be routed by Thu 17:00 UTC.
Marco (SE): Final canary results posted by Thu 16:00 UTC.
Priya (SE): KMS check in progress with infra.
Lydia (AE): Thanks team for the quick turnaround.
